## Header rhythm {.smaller}

{{< eyebrow "Eyebrow · slide title · subtitle" >}}

[The slide title is a plain `##`]{.slide-subtitle}

A normal `## Heading` is styled as the deck's `.slide-title` (64 px). The
mono uppercase **eyebrow** above it comes from `{{< eyebrow >}}`, and the
coral footer dot + `c/t` counter at the bottom are native (no Lua) — set
once via `footer:` in the YAML and `slide-number: c/t` in the format.

## Part 1 · Surfaces {.divider}

{{< eyebrow "Dividers are full-bleed teal" >}}

A `## Heading {.divider}` paints the whole 1920×1080 stage `$deck-primary`
with paper text — no footer, no counter.

## Global overview. {.divider .part-divider data-num="01"}

{{< eyebrow "Part 1 of 3" >}}

The richer section break — a giant numeral, a gold title and lede, and a
tracker rail showing which part you are entering.

:::: part-tracker
::: {.part .active}
[PART 01]{.num} Surfaces & cards
:::
::: part
[PART 02]{.num} Stats & layout
:::
::: part
[PART 03]{.num} Code & icons
:::
::::

## Cards & accents

{{< eyebrow "Native .cards grid + accent borders" >}}

:::{.cards}
:::{.card .top-accent}
[01]{.tag}

**Top accent**

A `.card.top-accent` draws a 6 px `$deck-primary` top border. Everything
inside is *real Markdown* — **bold**, *italic*, [links](#/cards-accents).
:::

:::{.card .left-accent}
**Left accent**

`.card.left-accent` draws a 4 px `$deck-accent` left border. Cards lift on
hover.
:::

:::{.card}
**Plain card**

A bare `.card` is a white surface on the paper stage with a hairline
border.
:::
:::

## Stat cards — two authoring paths

{{< eyebrow "Shortcode (draws the icon) vs Div filter (defers it)" >}}

:::{.cards}
{{< stat value="120k" label="Enrolments" icon=people accent >}}

{{< stat value="48" label="Countries" icon=geo-alt >}}

:::{.card .stat value="99.2%" label="Pipeline uptime" icon="speedometer2"}
:::
:::

The first two are `{{< stat >}}` shortcodes — they draw the registry SVG
into `.viz`. The third is the `:::{.card .stat …}` **Div filter** path: it
injects `.big`/`.kicker` but leaves `.viz` empty (the icon SVG is a known
B10 punch-list item). Use the shortcode for one-liners, the Div for cards
with rich Markdown bodies.

## The signature row — `.deck-grid`

{{< eyebrow "Arbitrary columns in one clean attribute" >}}

:::{.deck-grid cols="260px 380px 1fr 80px"}
:::{.card .left-accent}
[Layer 1 · The library]{.tag}

**Read in & clean up**

A *corpus* is every document we can find.
:::

:::{.card .left-accent}
[Layer 2 · The toolbox]{.tag}

**Query without a server**

DuckDB runs the analysis in-process.
:::

:::{.card .left-accent}
[Layer 3 · What you see]{.tag}

**The deck you're reading**

Pure Markdown, this format.
:::

:::{.card .stat value="3" label="Layers" icon="diagram-3"}
:::
:::

The `deck-layout.lua` filter turns `cols="…"` into a real CSS grid
(`grid-template-columns:260px 380px 1fr 80px;gap:40px`).

## Photo card

{{< eyebrow "Media banner + scrim over a body block" >}}

:::{.cards}
:::{.card .photo}
<div class="media" style="background-image:linear-gradient(135deg,#0E7A7A 0%,#159C9C 60%,#A8DCD9 100%)"></div>

:::{.body}
### Field data collection

Community health workers entering case data on tablets in the field.

:::{.meta}
[2024]{} · [Niger]{.country}
:::
:::
:::
:::

The `.media` carries a `background-image` (here a gradient stand-in for a
photo); the SCSS adds the bottom scrim. `.meta .country` is coral.

## Callout boxes

{{< eyebrow "Two tinted boxes for the read-this moments" >}}

::: {.callout-key}
The same six steps run for every document, end to end, from a single command.
:::

::: {.callout-warn}
{{< eyebrow "Watch out" >}}
A document that fails the metadata check is held back, not silently dropped.
:::

`.callout-key` reads teal on a pale teal tint; `.callout-warn` reads amber on
a pale amber tint. An optional `{{< eyebrow >}}` inside becomes the label.

## Before → after delta

{{< eyebrow "A compact card for a number moving" >}}

:::{.cards}
:::{.card .left-accent .delta}
[Total elements]{.label}

[1,240]{.from} [→]{.arrow} [310]{.to}
:::
:::

A `.card.delta` with three inline spans: `.from` is the old value (muted),
`.to` the new value (teal, bold), and `.arrow` the coral connector.

## Code & two-column split

{{< eyebrow "Native .columns + dark code, no hand-tokenizing" >}}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="45%"}
:::{.card .top-accent}
**DuckDB** runs the corpus queries in-process — no server, no daemon.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
```r
library(duckdb)

# A normal fenced block — the theme remaps
# skylighting tokens to the deck palette.
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "analysis.duckdb")
df <- dbGetQuery(con, "select * from records")
cat(nrow(df), "records loaded\n")
```
:::
::::

## Light code & the `.mono` helper

{{< eyebrow "Opt-in cream code surface + inline monospace" >}}

For a short snippet on a busy slide, add `.light` to the fence for a cream,
paper-toned block instead of the dark default:

```{.r .light}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "analysis.duckdb")
```

And wrap any inline text in `[…]{.mono}` to render it in JetBrains Mono —
handy for a file name like [data/clean.duckdb]{.mono} inside prose.

## Icon registry {#sec-icons .smaller}

{{< eyebrow "Bootstrap Icons, offline, currentColor" >}}

**Development —** {{< icon git >}} {{< icon code-slash >}} {{< icon database >}} {{< icon terminal >}} {{< icon rocket-takeoff >}} {{< icon box-seam >}} {{< icon diagram-3 >}} {{< icon gear >}}

**Statistics —** {{< icon bar-chart >}} {{< icon graph-up >}} {{< icon pie-chart >}} {{< icon table >}} {{< icon people >}} {{< icon geo-alt >}} {{< icon speedometer2 >}}

**Humanitarian —** {{< icon heart-pulse >}} {{< icon hospital >}} {{< icon globe-americas >}} {{< icon droplet >}} {{< icon shield-check >}} {{< icon bandaid >}}

Every glyph inherits the surrounding text colour, so a teal chip or a coral
stat tints it automatically. Add one by pasting a Bootstrap Icons path into
the registry table.

## Title decoration — `{{< dots >}}`

{{< eyebrow "Precomputed deterministic scatter" >}}

{{< dots >}}

The `{{< dots >}}` shortcode emits a fixed-seed SVG scatter (44 circles,
byte-identical every render) — the decorative figure the source decks
generated at runtime, recovered with no JS and no network.

## Tier switch {#sec-tier .divider}

{{< eyebrow "One line in _deck-tokens.scss" >}}

Everything here renders **Tier A** (deck-faithful teal/coral) by default.
Switch `$deck-primary` to `$col-primary` in `_deck-tokens.scss` for
**Tier B** (Epicentre navy) — same components, brand identity.
